processing: scripts/earth/build_earth_mesh.py ne_10m_land.geojson ne_10m_lakes.geojson ne_10m_roads.geojson 1 EarthLand.bin 0.005 0.01 0.0005 0.01 — polygons simplified to 0.005 degrees, land parts under 0.0005 and lakes under 0.01 square degrees dropped, clipped to one-degree cells and triangulated with GEOS constrained Delaunay (shapely 2.2, GEOS 3.14.1); roads of type Major Highway and Beltway kept as polylines simplified to 0.01 degrees.
